assumptions: All schools and item values are original design candidates, not installed gameplay.
Target count is the explicitly attainable geometric bound in each probe, not measured coverage of six real enemies.
Accuracy 0.65 is an independent linear expectation probe, not a simulated human or proc sequence.
Crit uses the current base expectation; TTK is a separate deterministic all-hit noncritical primary-target calculation.
No mastery, resonance, item inventory, AI, player health, shield survival, defense, travel pathfinding, or route duration is inferred.
Delayed damage is clipped at the observation horizon; summons have real finite lifetimes and occupancy in this model.
Group projectile probes use declared representative distance/component times rather than per-enemy flight arrival, so horizon-edge differences are an envelope approximation.
